author: Independent education critic: fresh Claude subagent (Claude Opus 5.5) with no authoring context, launched by crewmate pep-java-installing-design-followup; not the page author

items.note: Remains resolved on the corrected bytes. The recap section, now headed 'Now install on your own computer', keeps the four numbered steps (architecture per OS, JDK 25 - LTS with package type JDK from Temurin plus the per-OS official guide, Maven from the official guide with a new completion check, new-terminal verification), the network-access statement, expected java -version / javac -version / mvn -v output with 'all three show 25' as the pass rule, troubleshooting with a stop-and-ask-your-instructor boundary, and the IntelliJ IDEA starter/pom.xml and SDK 25 check. The added note that ARM-based Windows learners should ask the instructor is an explicit boundary, not a gap in the path.

The page heading was renamed to 'Now install on your own computer', exactly the heading the lab README line 12 names, so the lab-to-setup hand-off now lands. The README's description 'numbered steps for macOS, Linux and Windows' is still a looser fit (the steps now link to vendor guides rather than reproducing them) but is not false: the section is a numbered list that covers each OS. The README itself was deliberately left unedited, which is acceptable with this heading.

Partly fixed. Step 3 now has a completion check ('Done when mvn -v prints a Maven version in the next step'), and the cheat-sheet sentence is corrected so only the Temurin installer is said to set PATH and JAVA_HOME and the learner adds Maven's bin folder to Path themselves. Still open: a Windows learner is still given no route for editing Path, and no explicit 'ask your instructor if you have not edited Path before'. The linked Maven guide (fetched 2026-11-10, sha256 6af22f27...) says only that 'setting the path and environment variables depends on the OS' and offers Chocolatey or Scoop for Windows, and the troubleshooting line still says 'repeat the guide's PATH step', a step that has no Windows detail. The remaining gap is Windows-only and now low impact; the general stop-and-ask boundary catches learners eventually, after a failed check.

Not resolvable on this round: artifact.md was not regenerated and was not reviewed or bound, so the companion still has no link targets. On the HTML side, the author added visible plain-text addresses for the Temurin releases page, the Maven install guide and the JetBrains installation guide, which should survive derivation. But the per-OS Temurin guides (macOS .pkg, Windows .msi, Linux packages), the Maven download page, the IntelliJ IDEA SDKs page and the Sources list still have link text only, so even a regenerated companion would lack those addresses unless the derivation keeps hrefs. Recheck after regeneration.

Not addressed: artifact.md was not regenerated and the derivation is unchanged (no page-build or tooling change touches hint placement), so the two activity hints will still be emitted under the Markdown '## Cheat sheet' heading without their activity.

Activity 2 step 4 now reads 'A failed command shows an error message; read it and try again', which no longer claims real-bash fidelity. Unsupported java/javac/mvn arguments now print 'Only java -version, javac -version and mvn -v are available ... in this practice terminal', which is consistent with the simulation notice.
